Ayumi Tachibana came home for the long weekend to see her mother, Toshie, who was recovering from illness.{w}
Reunited with her mother at last, and joined by her old friend Reiko, she settled in to relax.{w}
But the next morning,{w:30} her mother had been taken to the police:{w:18} that was the news Reiko woke her with.{w}
She went to the police to see her mother, but was refused: Toshie was being questioned as a witness in a murder case.{w}
While she waited for her mother, Officer Yoneda explained the case to her.{w}
Gozo Kusano, former head of Ochidani Village, had been found dead in the annex of his home, stabbed in the chest by an unknown person.{w}
The one who found the body was Toshie Tachibana, and the only footprints around the scene were hers,{w:18} he said.{w}
Told the questioning would take a while, Ayumi decided to go home for now and wait for her mother there.{w}
Ayumi went home and heard the whole story from her family.{w}
The murdered Gozo Kusano had been on very bad terms with the Tachibanas, especially Ayumi's grandfather, Shinnosuke Tachibana.{w}
Curious about the Kusanos, Ayumi rushed out on impulse, but with so sudden a visit she learned nothing.{w}
But Reiko came after her, and from her Ayumi was able to hear about the Kusanos.{w}
Gozo Kusano was village head for many years, but retired 5 years ago and made his eldest son, Kazuo, his successor.{w}
His second son, Jiro, left the village and lives alone in Tokyo. To Gozo and the others, he seems to be a black sheep.{w}
On the way home, she asked around the village a little.{w}
Gozo Kusano and Shinnosuke Tachibana are oil and water. "Plenty disliked Gozo Kusano for forcing through the village's development."{w}
It's a curse! The ghosts of the fallen warriors! "You'd best leave the village, and soon."{w}
To learn what the villagers' strange words meant, she went to see Dr. Imada, Toshie's physician.{w}
As she heard how Ochidani Village began as a hidden village of fallen warriors, word came that Toshie had returned.{w}
But Toshie said she was tired, told her little, and went to sleep.{w}
